heading: Let's set up your company.
lead: Four steps, ~5 minutes. Any step can be skipped and returned to later.

company.title: What's your company name?
company.lead: This will be the workspace where your team sees metrics. You can change it later.
company.label: Company name

errors.too_short: Name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.too_long: Name must be at most 100 characters.

install.title: Install the agent
install.lead: Without the agent no events are collected. You can install it later — takes ~2 minutes.
install.extras: There's also a browser extension and git-hooks — see docs.

invite.title: Invite your team
invite.lead: Send an invite by email or generate a link to share directly.
invite.sent_ok: Email sent. If it doesn't arrive within 5 minutes — check Spam.
invite.url_note: 7 days, up to 10 uses per link. Free: up to 5 members. Revoke in Team → Members.

event.lead_waiting: Open your editor and code for a minute or two. As soon as the agent sends an event, the dashboard will come alive.
event.ts_tauri: Tauri agent is running (icon in menu-bar / system-tray)
event.ts_vscode: VS Code extension is active — open any .ts file
event.ts_browser: Browser extension is on — switch to ChatGPT / Claude
